name: Project Duke Data Centre

address.value: 2 and 10-22 Kent Road and 685 Gardeners Road, Mascot NSW
address.note: 22,923 sqm site (20,760 sqm before 685 Gardeners Rd was added by the July 2025 amendment); former Eaton warehouse site

postcode.note: suburb postcode (Australia Post); not stated in source

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 10-22 Kent Road (site also includes 2 Kent Rd and 685 Gardeners Rd)

builder.note: no head contractor announced as at 2026-09-27

mw_it.note: Assessment Report Table 1: 'Total power consumption of 120 megawatts (MW), with IT load of up to 85 MW' (amended scheme)

mw_grid.note: total power consumption up to 120MW after the 4 Jul 2025 amendment (from circa 90MW / 90MVA in the exhibited EIS); portal description still reads '90 MVA data centre'

cost_aud_m.note: Estimated development cost $1,177,672,175 (Assessment Report; Linesight amended EDC report, excl. GST). EIS at lodgement: $913,345,196.44 (excl. GST) for the original 90MVA scheme (source 9)

authority.note: Minister is consent authority; determined by Director, Industry Assessments under the 9 Mar 2022 delegation

lodged.note: approximate: EIS uploaded 7 Nov 2024; exhibited 15 Nov-12 Dec 2024; amendment submitted 4 Jul 2025 and accepted 7 Jul 2025

determined.note: Determination Date 22/12/2025 on planning portal (verified 2026-09-27); decider Director

jobs_construction.note: Assessment Report: '600 full-time equivalent construction jobs' / 'up to 600 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; no period or peak/average definition given (construction up to 110 weeks). The exhibited EIS gave no construction jobs figure

jobs_operational.note: EIS staff-per-shift calculation: 'the total number of operational jobs for the proposal is 30 jobs'; Assessment Report: '30 ongoing operational roles'

construction_start.note: not announced; Assessment Report: construction would take up to 110 weeks

open_questions: builder and construction start not announced
